# BlackWater Marketing

> BlackWater Marketing is a performance-driven paid social advertising agency specializing in Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram) and TikTok Ads for e-commerce, DTC, and apparel brands. Founded by Jack Carnes.

## What we do
- Meta Ads management (Facebook & Instagram)
- TikTok Ads
- Ad creative strategy & generation
- Full-funnel strategy & conversion rate optimization (CRO)
- Email & SMS marketing
- B2B marketing & CRM automation

## Who we help
E-commerce and direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands — apparel, supplement, jewelry, and other online stores — that want more sales from paid social advertising on Meta and TikTok.

## Results
- $1M+ generated for clients
- 4.2x average return on ad spend (ROAS)
- $7.32 average cost per acquisition
- 500+ ad creatives tested across 35+ clients
